rules.title: Every operation has a clear operationId
rules.fix: Give each operation an operationId that says what it does (listOrders, refundOrder). It becomes the tool name.

rules.title: Every operation has a summary
rules.fix: Add a short summary (under 80 characters): clients show it as the tool's title.

rules.title: Descriptions say what the operation does, when to use it, and what it returns
rules.fix: Write a description of at least 40 characters per operation, different from the others: models pick tools by it.

rules.title: Parameters are described
rules.fix: Describe each parameter: its meaning, format and allowed values.

rules.title: Parameters with a fixed set of values list them
rules.fix: Give status/sort/type-like parameters an enum (or list the values in the description).

rules.title: Operations have an example
rules.fix: Add an example for each operation (a parameter, request or response example): models copy examples.

rules.title: Request bodies are JSON
rules.fix: Accept application/json for request bodies agents send (form and multipart bodies can't be tool calls).

rules.title: Success responses have a JSON schema
rules.fix: Describe what a 2xx response contains with a JSON schema, so agents know what they'll get back.

rules.title: Errors are described
rules.fix: Document the errors an operation returns (400, 404, 409…) so agents can recover instead of retrying blindly.

rules.title: List endpoints are paginated
rules.fix: Give list operations a limit and a cursor (or page) parameter: an agent can't read ten thousand rows.

rules.title: How to authenticate is described
rules.fix: Describe your auth in components.securitySchemes and apply it with security.

findings.message: security schemes are defined but not applied

rules.title: Writes have an idempotency story
rules.fix: Accept an Idempotency-Key header on POST/PATCH (Agentify honours it for agents), so a retry doesn't do the work twice.

rules.title: A manageable number of tools, with distinct names
rules.fix: Keep enabled tools to about 40 per server (models choose worse from long lists), and give operations distinct operationIds.
